narration: There is a second reason for the pole. Light. The idea of a sunless pole is wrong.
visual_brief: Sunlit ridge at the lunar pole with a blazing low sun.

candidates.title: NASA's LRO Discovers Lunar Hydrogen More Abundant on Moon's Pole-Facing Slopes
candidates.description: Space travel is difficult and expensive – it would cost thousands of dollars to launch a bottle of water to the moon.
